caption: The drawing shows a single, large, round plate centered on a plain, off-white background. The plate is predominantly black in color, with a wide border decorated with a swirling pattern of yellow and gold lines. Interspersed along the border are several small floral motifs in light brown and red, and there are also some small, scattered red and white dots. The plate appears uniformly dark in the central area, fading slightly toward the edge where the decorative border begins. No other objects or patterns are present in the drawing.
